hardwareHubs.note: Mississippi State University runs The Factory maker space with CNC, laser cutter and 3D printers.

makerspaces.name: The Factory (MSU Maker Space)
makerspaces.note: Lists an X-Carve CNC mill, laser cutter, metal and wood tools, electronics tools and Stratasys 3D printers on the university campus.

makerspaces.name: Jackson County FabLab
makerspaces.note: Lists laser engravers, 3D printers, vinyl cutters and wood routers, with a mobile unit that visits schools.

makerspaces.name: IDEAlab
makerspaces.note: University of Mississippi library makerspace listing a 3D printer and Arduino and Raspberry Pi electronics kits.

events.name: Maker Faire Meridian
events.note: The Mississippi Industrial Heritage Museum runs it; the most recent edition confirmed was the 7th in 2022.

programs.name: Mississippi State University Entrepreneurship Center
programs.note: Runs The Factory maker space with the Bagley College of Engineering.

specialties.name: Automotive
specialties.note: An industry article ties supplier growth to the Toyota Blue Springs and Nissan Canton plants.

specialties.name: Polymers and plastics
specialties.note: An industry article says the state promoted plastics and polymers as a target cluster, supported by the Mississippi Polymer Institute at the University of Southern Mississippi.

specialties.name: Aerospace and space testing
specialties.note: An industry article describes NASA Stennis Space Center as the largest rocket engine test complex in the US.

support.name: Mississippi Business Alliance (MSBA-MEP)
support.note: NIST MEP center offering workforce training and facility planning help to Mississippi manufacturers.
